description: This file defines the 'FormattedCell' class, which manages the rendering and layout calculations for a table cell in a document, including content sizing, area provisioning, and formatting within the MigraDoc library.

classes.name: FormattedCell
classes.description: Represents a formatted table cell with layout and rendering capabilities within MigraDoc.

methods.name: CalcContentRect
methods.description: Calculates the rectangle area for the cell content based on column widths and padding.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Performs formatting of the cell content using graphics context.

methods.name: GetRenderInfos
methods.description: Retrieves rendering information for the cell content.

methods.name: CalcContentHeight
methods.description: Calculates the total height of the cell content.
